Third-party files in pcore/web (all usable offline, no CDN; copied from nas/web/vendor):

fonts/AdwaitaSans.woff2, fonts/AdwaitaMono.woff2
  Adwaita Sans / Adwaita Mono (GNOME), subset to Latin.
  SIL Open Font License 1.1 – https://openfontlicense.org

fonts/pshell-icons.woff2
  The Material Design Icons glyphs of "Symbols Nerd Font" that
  style/theme/Icons.qml names (js/icons.js maps the names).
  Nerd Fonts: MIT License. Material Design Icons: Apache License 2.0
  (Pictogrammers).

qrcode.js
  QRCode for JavaScript, Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase, MIT License,
  as ported to node by qrcode-terminal (Apache License 2.0), bundled into one
  ES module.
